import math

# Data from table FD-1 (in millions of dollars)
# Years: FY 1995, 1996, 1997, 1998, 1999
# Government accounts - public debt securities (column 5)
gov_accounts = [1320784, 1447001, 1598459, 1765580, 1989072]

# The public - public debt securities (column 8)
public_held = [3653199, 3777810, 3814687, 3760613, 3667199]

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates: ln(Dt/Dt-1)
# For periods: 1995->1996, 1996->1997, 1997->1998, 1998->1999
def calc_log_growth(data):
    growth_rates = []
    for i in range(1, len(data)):
        rate = math.log(data[i] / data[i-1])
        growth_rates.append(rate)
    return growth_rates

gov_growth = calc_log_growth(gov_accounts)
pub_growth = calc_log_growth(public_held)

print("Government accounts - Public Debt Securities - Log growth rates:")
for i, r in enumerate(gov_growth):
    print(f"  {1995+i}->{1996+i}: {r}")

print("\nPublic held - Public Debt Securities - Log growth rates:")
for i, r in enumerate(pub_growth):
    print(f"  {1995+i}->{1996+i}: {r}")

# Calculate population standard deviation and mean
import statistics

def calc_cv(data):
    n = len(data)
    mean = sum(data) / n
    # Population standard deviation
    variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in data) / n
    std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
    cv = std_dev / mean
    return cv, std_dev, mean

gov_cv, gov_std, gov_mean = calc_cv(gov_growth)
pub_cv, pub_std, pub_mean = calc_cv(pub_growth)

print(f"\nGovernment accounts: mean={gov_mean}, std={gov_std}, CV={gov_cv}")
print(f"Public held: mean={pub_mean}, std={pub_std}, CV={pub_cv}")

abs_diff = abs(gov_cv - pub_cv)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandth: {round(abs_diff, 3)}")
EOF
